scope: Bounded follow-up to merged PR #981 after independent Opus 5 review. This artifact is committed before implementation and predicts only certification-contract behavior.

checkpoint_population.one_record_for_two_games: FAIL: the manifest/readout must reject a checkpoint with fewer records or distinct seeds than its paired shard report games.
checkpoint_population.incomplete_report_provenance: FAIL: a shard report with checkpoint_provenance.complete != true or records_with_provenance != games must be rejected even when checkpoint rows individually carry valid provenance.
checkpoint_population.complete_population: PASS: one gated, provenance-bearing checkpoint row per shard game with the report's complete provenance scalar remains acceptable.

classification_order.minority_absorb: UNATTRIBUTED with absorb_through_protect_or_miss even when its matching miss is not the majority arm.
classification_order.minority_same_turn_stat: UNATTRIBUTED with same_turn_stat_event_gap even when a different arm has majority miss mass.
classification_order.minority_structural_count: UNATTRIBUTED with structural_component_count_without_supported_sibling before I2 can classify a small total miss mass.
classification_order.all_emittable_counters: Every EMITTABLE_EXCLUSION_COUNTERS member has a direct classifier regression at minority mass; observed nonzero still fails its predicted-zero gate.

manifest_schema.producer: FAIL before writing a v2 manifest when any required per-shard probe record field is missing or malformed.
manifest_schema.consumer: FAIL when a syntactically valid JSON manifest diverges from the bounded v2 schema; producer and consumer agree on valid fixture output.

build_fingerprint.inputs: Changing Cargo.toml or Cargo.lock in either the vendored engine tree or rust/pokezero-search changes the content fingerprint.
build_fingerprint.freshness: The mtime freshness defense considers both manifests/locks as build inputs, so a stale artifact predating a changed Cargo input is rejected when content does not match.

aggregate_alignment.missing_scalar: FAIL: absent aggregate shard scalar values are malformed, never silently counted as zero.
aggregate_alignment.misaligned_paths: FAIL: unordered/malformed seed summaries cannot cause zip-based report-path alignment to attach provenance failures to a different shard.

family_rates.lower: Advisory only: an observed rate below a Wilson lower bound is recorded but does not fail certification without a separately declared prediction-interval gate.
family_rates.upper: Binding: an observed rate above the registered upper rate still fails certification.
family_rates.unchanged_hard_gates: Zero unattributed rows and predicted-zero exclusion counters remain binding.

verification_plan: Focused cert manifest/readout/build-stamp tests, including new negative population, schema, ordering, scalar, alignment, and rate-gate regressions.
Public invariant tests and broader relevant engine certification tests.
Python compilation, JSON parsing, and git diff --check.
